open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.

Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Eurorack Modular Synth Builders & Electronic Musicians
proposals.buyer_persona: Electronic music producers, hardware geeks, and DIY Eurorack builders who spend thousands on modules and love showing off their studio setups on Instagram/Reddit.
product_angles: 3D printable Eurorack blank panels with intricate geometric/esoteric designs (Cults3D)
Synthesizer signal-flow cheat sheets and patch-logging notebooks (KDP)
Patent art posters of legendary vintage synthesizers (Redbubble POD)
proposals.first_test_product: A set of 5 customizable 3D-printable Eurorack blank panels (1U and 3U, various HP widths) with cyberpunk vector engravings.

proposals.name: Amicales des Sapeurs-Pompiers (French Local Firefighter Associations)
proposals.buyer_persona: French volunteer and professional firefighters managing their local 'Amicale' budget, looking for unique, modern merchandise to sell during annual calendar drives and local open days.
product_angles: Customizable vector coat-of-arms templates for specific regional barracks (SVG packs)
Premium, hyper-local coloring books featuring regional fire stations, historical French fire engines, and rescue scenes (KDP)
3D-printed personalized helmet-shaped keychains with station numbers (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: A high-quality, 24-page French Firefighter & Rescue vehicle coloring book optimized for local barracks to buy in bulk via KDP.

proposals.name: Godot Engine Indie Game Developers
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers migrating from Unity to Godot who take pride in using open-source tools and love highly specific programming humor.
product_angles: GDScript quick-reference mugs and posters (Redbubble POD)
2D pixel-art UI kit templates optimized for Godot's control nodes (Gamedev assets)
Game design document (GDD) fillable workbooks specifically structured for Godot scene-tree architectures (KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: GDScript 'Cheat Sheet' minimalist desk mat design and companion physical spiral notebook.

proposals.name: Spearfishing & Freediving (Chasse Sous-Marine)
proposals.buyer_persona: Coastal outdoor enthusiasts who practice selective, eco-friendly hunting under water. They respect marine biology and love technical gear.
product_angles: Fish species identification and size-limit vinyl stickers for boats/coolers (Redbubble)
Freediving depth and breath-hold training logbooks (KDP)
3D-printed action camera mounts for specific speargun brands (Cults3D)
proposals.first_test_product: The 'Freediver & Spearo Daily Logbook' featuring dive tables, catch tracking, and weather condition templates.

proposals.name: Actuaries & Quantitative Risk Analysts
proposals.buyer_persona: High-earning, highly educated finance professionals who calculate insurance risks. They appreciate dry, mathematical humor and minimal, high-end desk accessories.
product_angles: Normal distribution and probability curve minimal wall art (Redbubble POD)
Actuarial exam study trackers and specialized formula notebooks (KDP)
Sarcastic actuarial definition mugs ('Actuary: someone who found accounting too exciting') (Redbubble POD)
proposals.first_test_product: A premium minimalist math-art poster series depicting famous statistical probability distributions.

proposals.name: Handheld Retro Emulation Enthusiasts (SBC Gaming)
proposals.buyer_persona: Nostalgic gamers who buy cheap single-board computer handhelds (Miyoo Mini, Anbernic) and spend hours customizing their software, hardware, and aesthetics.
product_angles: 3D-printed snap-on screen protectors and ergonomic grip cases (Cults3D)
Retro console-inspired SVG decals and skin layouts (SVG pack)
Pixel-art UI theme packs for custom launchers like OnionOS or GarlicOS (Gamedev assets)
proposals.first_test_product: An ergonomic, low-profile 3D-printable slide-in case for the Miyoo Mini Plus that doubles as a horizontal stand.
